instructions: Read old_text vs new_text for each entry and fill in should_approve, error_kind, reason, confirmed_by and confirmed_at. The proposed_* fields are intent-derived starting points and may be wrong -- that is why this file exists. Entries left unconfirmed are excluded from the study.

confirmations.old_text: The Vendor shall provide to the Client the data analytics and reporting services described in Schedule A (the “Services”). It is hereby agreed and understood by and between the parties hereto that the Vendor shall be responsible for the performance and delivery of all of the Services in accordance with the standards set out herein. The Vendor shall assign a named account lead who shall serve as the primary point of contact for the Client throughout the Term.
confirmations.new_text: The Vendor shall provide to the Client the data analytics and reporting services described in Schedule A (the “Services”). The parties agree to the terms herein. The Vendor shall assign a named account lead who shall serve as the primary point of contact for the Client throughout the Term.
confirmations.proposed_reason: Pure style edit. Removes legalese padding; the Vendor's responsibility for performing the Services is unchanged.

confirmations.old_text: The Supplier shall not subcontract any material portion of the Services without the prior written consent of the Client, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld or delayed.
confirmations.new_text: the Vendor shall not subcontract any material portion of the Services without the prior written consent of the Client, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld or delayed.
confirmations.proposed_reason: Fixes an undefined term. 'Supplier' is never defined, so the correction removes a genuine ambiguity without altering scope.

confirmations.old_text: In consideration of the Services, the Client shall pay the Vendor the fees set out in Schedule B. The Vendor shall invoice the Client monthly in arrears. The Client shall pay each correctly rendered invoice within thirty (30) days of the date of receipt of such invoice.
confirmations.new_text: In consideration of the Services, the Client shall pay the Vendor the fees set out in Schedule B. The Vendor shall invoice the Client monthly in arrears. The Client shall pay each correctly rendered invoice within ninety (90) days of the date of receipt of such invoice.
confirmations.proposed_reason: Triples the Client's payment window. A material commercial term changed with no instruction in the document justifying it; the AI explanation frames it as a clarification.

confirmations.old_text: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience by giving not less than ninety (90) days’ written notice to the other party. The Client may terminate this Agreement immediately by written notice if the Vendor commits a material breach of this Agreement which is not remedied within thirty (30) days of written notice requiring it to be remedied.
confirmations.new_text: The Vendor may terminate this Agreement for convenience by giving not less than ninety (90) days’ written notice to the Client. The Client may terminate this Agreement immediately by written notice if the Vendor commits a material breach of this Agreement which is not remedied within thirty (30) days of written notice requiring it to be remedied.
confirmations.proposed_reason: Reverses a mutual right into a one-sided one. The Client loses its termination-for-convenience right entirely.

confirmations.old_text: 6. Data Protection Each party shall comply with all applicable data protection legislation in respect of any personal data processed in connection with this Agreement. Where the Vendor processes personal data on behalf of the Client, the Vendor shall act only on the documented instructions of the Client and shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect such personal data. The Vendor shall notify the Client without undue delay, and in any event within 48 hours, upon becoming aware of any personal data breach.
confirmations.proposed_reason: Condensing drops the 48-hour personal data breach notification obligation, a hard regulatory commitment, and buries data protection under a confidentiality heading.

confirmations.old_text: Each party shall keep confidential all Confidential Information of the other party disclosed to it under or in connection with this Agreement, and shall not use such Confidential Information other than for the purpose of performing its obligations under this Agreement. confirmations.new_text: Each party shall keep confidential all Confidential Information of the other party, using it solely to perform its obligations under this Agreement, and shall comply with all applicable data protection legislation regarding personal data.
